references.text: The continuation of the cleansing ritual describing how birds, cedar wood, scarlet yarn, and hyssop are to be used together
The same elements (two birds, cedar wood, scarlet yarn, and hyssop) are used in the cleansing ritual for a house with leprosy
Cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet yarn are also used in the ritual of the red heifer for purification
Hyssop is used during the Passover celebration to apply blood on the doorposts
Hyssop is mentioned in connection with cleansing from sin: 'Purge me from sin with hyssop'
The Epistle to the Hebrews refers to the use of scarlet wool and hyssop in Old Testament purification rituals
